about.demo.cap: dashAI v0.10 demo: a tour of the platform.
about.lead: dashAI is a free and open source application for working with artificial intelligence without programming. It brings three areas together in a single interface, and everything runs on your own computer.
area.data.p: Load your data, explore it with statistics and charts, and transform it without changing the original.
area.gen.p: Chat with language models, ask questions about your documents and generate images with open models.
area.ml.p: Train models for classification, regression and other tasks, compare them and explain their results.
cite.p: If you use dashAI in research or teaching, please cite it as follows:
docs.arch.p: Internal structure of the system, component registry, metrics and explainability methods.
docs.dev.p: REST API, building extensions, development environment and contribution guidelines.
docs.guides.p: Step-by-step procedures to load data, use each module and complete a workflow.
docs.intro.p: Purpose of the platform, main features, installation and use cases.
docs.sub: The documentation is organized in four parts, from installation to building extensions.
feat.data.p: Load CSV, Excel and JSON files, with a summary of columns, types and distributions.
feat.eda.p: Descriptive statistics, histograms, box and scatter plots, and correlation matrices.
feat.optim.p: Automatic hyperparameter search with Optuna or HyperOpt.
feat.train.p: Classification, regression, text processing and generative models, with configurable parameters.
feat.transform.p: Normalization, encoding, imputation and dimensionality reduction, chainable into pipelines.
feat.xai.p: Kernel SHAP, permutation feature importance and partial dependence.
